approval_steps_required_mode.name: approval_steps_required_mode
approval_steps_required_mode.value: "approval_steps"."required_mode" IN ('count', 'all') AND ("approval_steps"."required_mode" = 'all' OR "approval_steps"."required_approvals" IS NOT NULL)

files_ready_confirmed.name: files_ready_confirmed
files_ready_confirmed.value: "files"."status" = 'pending' OR ("files"."etag" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."uploaded_at" IS NOT NULL)

files_variant_ready_described.name: files_variant_ready_described
files_variant_ready_described.value: "files"."variant_status" <> 'ready' OR ("files"."image_width" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."image_height" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."variant_format" IS NOT NULL)

refresh_tokens_idp_session_idx.name: refresh_tokens_idp_session_idx
refresh_tokens_idp_session_idx.where: "refresh_tokens"."idp_session_uid" IS NOT NULL AND "refresh_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NULL

users_username_key.name: users_username_key
users_username_key.where: "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "users"."username" IS NOT NULL

data_transfers_mode_check.name: data_transfers_mode_check
data_transfers_mode_check.value: ("data_transfers"."direction" = 'import' AND "data_transfers"."mode" IN ('create', 'update')) OR ("data_transfers"."direction" = 'export' AND "data_transfers"."mode" IS NULL)

org_units_code_key.name: org_units_code_key
org_units_code_key.where: "org_units"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "org_units"."code" IS NOT NULL
